concerns.text: FR-002 mandates ingestion of Landsat LST from USGS EarthExplorer, but the plan documents that EarthExplorer is credential/interactive-gated and no verified open LST URL exists. The plan correctly refuses to fabricate data (SC-002) and implements a DATA_GAP contract, but FR-002 as written is unsatisfiable by the planned pipeline — the spec must be amended to name a verified, programmatically downloadable LST product or authorize a checksummed local asset. Until then FR-002 and the end-to-end execution of SC-002/US-01 have no executable backing.

FR-010's UpperBound_R² = 0.68 (Zhou et al. 2020) has no verified source in the project's verified block; the plan computes the metric from the spec-stated constant and labels it provisional. The spec's citation is unverified, so FR-010's 'literature-grounded ceiling' claim is not backed by a verified reference — spec amendment or Reference-Validator verification is required before the metric can be reported as literature-grounded.
